implementation.checkpoint_policy: No upstream assay checkpoint is admitted. Every model and bias model is trained inside the outer donor and genomic folds, and every produced HDF5 artifact receives a project SHA-256.

inference_contract.donor_context: none; one training-donor-pooled prediction per cell state and locus is repeated across held donors and labeled sequence_only
inference_contract.native_lane: same architecture and outputs; native preprocessing is the fixed ChromBPNet peak/profile pipeline
inference_contract.profile_prediction: Use the bias-free TF model for biological accessibility predictions; retain full bias-factorized output only as an assay-QC diagnostic.
inference_contract.reverse_complement: mean predictions from forward and reverse-complement sequences after reversing the RC profile to reference orientation
inference_contract.variant_primary_score: ALT_minus_REF bias-free log_total_count, averaged across reverse complements and the five fixed seeds
inference_contract.variant_profile_diagnostic: ALT-minus-REF bias-free 1000-bp profile after orientation restoration
inference_contract.variant_to_gene_limit: ChromBPNet predicts sequence-driven accessibility, not enhancer-gene links or signed expression effects. Signed gene-effect scoring requires a separately frozen linking and direction rule and is reported as a composite, never as ChromBPNet alone.

input_contract.atac_shift: Unstranded insertion bigWig normalized to +4/-4 for ATAC; auto-detection is diagnostic and its inferred source shift is frozen per input artifact.
input_contract.canonical_sequence: GRCh38.p14 one-hot ACGT sequence from the project reference with REF-allele validation
input_contract.peak_definition: Training-fold-only 10-column narrowPeak records centered at start plus summit; held donors and held genomic blocks cannot affect the peak universe.
input_contract.profile_supervision: Raw Tn5 insertion counts pseudobulked within outer-training donor by cell state before pooling; cells and fragments are not inferential replicates.
input_contract.negative_definition: Training-fold-only GC-, mappability-, accessibility-, and distance-matched nonpeak regions; negative_sampling_ratio is frozen at 0.1 unless changed before the campaign lock.
input_contract.reference: GRCh38.p14 plus the frozen GENCODE v49 project contract
input_contract.training_augmentation: Maximum 500-bp jitter and 0.5 reverse-complement fraction, with deterministic row IDs and seed.
input_contract.warning: The upstream pipeline accepts BAM, fragment, tagAlign, or bigWig inputs. The benchmark canonicalizes to hashed fragments plus a derived insertion bigWig; input format cannot vary by fold or model.

source_evidence: The full pinned repository commit and PyPI 1.0.1 metadata were queried on 2026-08-22. Source code was inspected without installing the package or running TensorFlow. No pretrained model was downloaded.
